subject: Renewal: EU residency + APAC staged hot-standby capacity
messages:
From: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@mediprime.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — residency & APAC pilot

Hi Ben,

Our contract with Redwood is up for renewal in October and we need to lock in two things before legal signs:

- EU-only data residency for EU traffic (GDPR requirement for a subset of our customers).
- A staged APAC onramp with a hot-standby / failover arrangement for Q4 pilot traffic (initial 3 months).

Can you share options for term length, any price delta for EU-exclusive tenancy, and what hot-standby pricing looks like versus warm standby? Also curious about encryption/KMS options and whether we can bring our own keys.

We'd like to get a draft SOW and a capacity schedule to review by next week so procurement can start internal approvals.

Thanks,
Sarah Turner
Head of Platform Operations
MediPrime Health
Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@mediprime.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — residency & APAC pilot

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear ask.

Summary of what we can do and next steps:

- EU residency: we can provision an EU-dedicated tenancy for your EU traffic. Term-based pricing: 12-month commit, 24-month commit (discounts apply). I attached a draft SOW (redwood_sow_v3.pdf) and a preliminary capacity schedule (medi_prime_capacity_schedule.xlsx) for the options.
- APAC staged onramp: recommend a 3-month hot-standby window (failover enabled) followed by a decision point to convert to dedicated or fall back to hosted. Hot-standby pricing shown as an uplift in the attached schedule.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM-backed KMS — will include required audit docs in the security checklist.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call Monday to walk the SOW? I included Mina (ops and pricing) on the thread so she can advise on committed capacity levels and any available renewal credits.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachments: redwood_sow_v3.pdf, medi_prime_capacity_schedule.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — residency & APAC pilot (internal pricing notes)

Ben / Lauren — internal notes for the call: 

- Pricing approach: propose 20% uplift on committed EU CPU/GPU units to cover dedicated tenancy overhead (12-month commit). Offer 10% discount if they commit 24 months.
- Hot-standby mechanics: bill at 30% of full dedicated rate while on standby (capacity reserved but preemptible for internal burst). Actual failover traffic billed at the committed per-token rate when active. This keeps predictable unit economics for MediPrime.
- Credits: we can offer a one-time renewal credit equal to one month of committed EU capacity if they sign within 21 days.
- Security: BYOK supported; need to confirm key rotation windows and what logs they require for audit. Recommend we attach the security_checklist.pdf to the SOW.

Action items before Monday:
- Ben: confirm which SOW variant (12m vs 24m) MediPrime prefers on the call.
- Lauren: prepare draft canary/failover runbook snippet for inclusion (short paragraph).
- Me: prepare a final price table and the proposed renewal credit clause.

Mina
Sr. Solutions & Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Tom Li <tom.li@mediprime.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@mediprime.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:40:00 -0700

Ben / Sarah — quick replies from procurement/security after a fast internal review: 

- The 12-month commit with hot-standby sounds acceptable as a pilot. Procurement prefers the 12m with the option to convert after the 3-month pilot.
- Security needs a short doc clarifying BYOK (we control key lifecycle) and proof of HSM separation; I attached a brief security checklist with the exact questions.
- Please include an explicit failover SLA: max RTO 60s for APAC failover, and a documented rollback plan if failover causes errors.

We can get signature to legal if those items are in the SOW and a revised DocuSign link is provided. Looking to complete by Wednesday EOD.

Tom Li
Director, Procurement | MediPrime Health
